Chapter 509: Chapter 10 Three Treasures (Please Subscribe)_2

Yet merely relying on these annotations made it difficult to fully understand the treasure reward and to ascertain whether it was suitable for oneself.

“Senior Shen Ji,” Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted from the reward list to the stone statue Shen Ji standing beside him, “I’m unsure which three treasure rewards to choose.”

Lin Yuan found it hard to make a choice because he was unfamiliar with these reward treasures.

But as the keeper of this trial space, the stone statue Shen Ji, who had control over the rewards for each layer, certainly knew the value of each treasure.

“Would you like me to choose for you?” An unusual expression appeared on the face of the stone statue Shen Ji.

Normally, he was too lazy to bother with these matters, but having been lonely for many years, coupled with Lin Yuan exhibiting an unreasonable and incomprehensible talent, he was quite willing to offer his suggestions.

...

“Are you looking to select the most valuable treasure rewards or the ones most suitable for you?” the stone statue Shen Ji asked, needing to understand Lin Yuan’s needs to offer specific suggestions.

“The ones suitable for me,” Lin Yuan said without hesitation.

Most of the treasures on the reward list were ones Lin Yuan had never even heard of, suggesting they might be hard to acquire even in the Main World.

Therefore, it was best to choose the most suitable ones, as the value of a treasure was irrelevant if it could not be utilized properly.

“Then I do have some thoughts,” the stone statue Shen Ji observed Lin Yuan for a moment, then spoke earnestly, “For you, right now, the most critical thing is to fully comprehend the Complete Space Rules.”

“Fully comprehend the Complete Space Rules?” Lin Yuan was slightly taken aback.

“Normal beings of the Eighth Layer indeed don’t need to fully comprehend the Complete Space Rules to break through to the Ninth Rank,” the stone statue Shen Ji glanced at Lin Yuan.

“Because given the vastness of the Space Rules, it is sufficient to grasp just a small portion to encompass and integrate with other rules,” the stone statue Shen Ji said.

“Right,” Lin Yuan nodded.

The Taiyin Rule and Taiyang Rule could be integrated only when Lin Yuan had completely understood both.

This is because the Taiyin Rule and Taiyang Rule are on the same level, and to integrate them, it is necessary to fully comprehend both.

However, the Space Rules are a foundational rule, far surpassing ordinary rules in vastness, and integration with ordinary rules doesn’t require full comprehension.

“But this is under normal circumstances,” the stone statue Shen Ji sighed, “Even though some beings of the Eighth Layer who discover several types of Cosmic Force might blend them with ordinary rules into the Space Rules when breaking through to the Ninth Rank,”

“it hardly impacts them much,” he continued, pausing briefly, “but you have discovered too many types of Cosmic Force, including one that is of the Source-level.”

“For you to step into the Ninth Rank, you must comprehend the Complete Space Rules fully,” he added.

“Only with the Complete Space Rules can you support the numerous types of Cosmic Force you have discovered,” the stone statue Shen Ji finished and fell silent.

“So that’s it,” Lin Yuan suddenly realized.

No wonder he had been struggling recently with the integration of the rules; it was because the Space Rules he had grasped were insufficient.

This wasn’t surprising since the Human Alliance in the Main World’s description of how to ascend to the Ninth Rank never mentioned how to integrate so many types of Cosmic Force.

Moreover, since Lin Yuan had not revealed that he had discovered numerous types of Cosmic Force, others, even if willing, could not provide relevant advice.

“So, I recommend the first treasure you should choose is ‘Void Interpretation,'” the stone statue Shen Ji slowly said.

“‘Void Interpretation’?” Lin Yuan’s eyes lit up as he immediately found the description of the treasure in the reward list.

“‘Void Interpretation’ is the Moyu Tower Master’s interpretation and understanding of space.”

The explanation was brief, but what caught Lin Yuan’s attention was that this “Void Interpretation” came from the Moyu Tower Master.

“Space Rules are boundless and infinite; what we call complete mastery of Space Rules is merely mastering certain aspects. The master’s ‘Void Interpretation’ offers another perspective to interpret and understand the Space Rules,”

“and this, for you, should be very useful, even if you eventually comprehend the Complete Space Rules, it will still be effective,” the stone statue explained seriously while looking at Lin Yuan.

“Good.”

“I’ll choose that one,” Lin Yuan immediately said.

What kind of being is the Moyu Tower Master? A single phrase from him is invaluable, let alone a complete “Void Interpretation”?

Thus, after hearing the suggestion from Stone Statue Shen Ji, Lin Yuan made up his mind.

“Very well.”

A smile appeared on the face of Stone Statue Shen Ji.

Although Lin Yuan possessed a talent and aptitude rarely seen in the world, even the Demonic Jade Tower Master at the Eighth Layer was far inferior.

However, even the most extraordinary talent needs to follow the correct path to be effective, and in the reward repository of the first and second layers of the Nine Floors Dark Tower, there was no lack of treasures that greatly enhanced combat power.

Yet on the path of life’s evolution, the usefulness of combat power is far less than the transformation of life itself.

“This is ‘Void Interpretation,’ the masterwork of my lord, I hope you will comprehend it well,” Stone Statue Shen Ji waved his right hand.

A silver-white book appeared in the air, over a meter tall, radiating faint spatial fluctuations. Lin Yuan, gazing at the book, felt as if he was looking at the vast Space Rules.

“This…”

Lin Yuan stared at the silver-white book. Characters of silver-white began to detach from the book, moving towards Lin Yuan, merging into his forehead one after another.

One after another, the silver-white characters, each containing a massive amount of information, if written using human civilization’s language, even tens of millions of words would not adequately express it.

Finally, three thousand three hundred and thirty-three silver-white characters merged into Lin Yuan’s forehead, after which the entire silver-white book began to disintegrate, disappearing without a trace.

Lin Yuan closed his eyes.

At the same time.

On the Milky Way Main Star, Lin Yuan’s true body also closed his eyes.

In the depths of his mind, three thousand three hundred and thirty-three silver-white characters emitted a silvery glow. Lin Yuan carefully examined each character, never realizing before how much, how profound, information just one character could convey.

[Your comprehension is against the heavens, watching the mystic text rapidly enhances your understanding of the Space Rules…]

…

[Your comprehension is against the heavens, watching the mystic text rapidly enhances your understanding of the Space Rules…]

…

[Your comprehension is against the heavens, watching the mystic text rapidly enhances your understanding of the Space Rules…]

…

With each moment, an abundance of inspiration about Space surged into his mind. Lin Yuan had never thought that spacing could also be comprehended this way. It was not purely understanding of Space, but also of the Five Elements, of lightning, of light, and so forth, delving deeper and deeper into understanding Space.

Buzz.

Just moments later,

Lin Yuan felt he had comprehended four core spatial models in succession.

“Struck it big.”

Lin Yuan steadied his spirit, his attention reluctantly moving away from the characters in his mind.

“Worthy of the Demonic Jade Tower Master’s interpretation of space,” Lin Yuan was excited, “Each character contains endless depth, presenting a perspective on space different from that of human civilization.”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath.

He felt that even a Supreme Being, upon viewing this “Void Interpretation,” would be deeply moved.

Supreme Beings had comprehended complete Rules of Time, Complete Space Rules, but each Supreme Being’s understanding of these rules was different.

…

Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes.

“Void Interpretation” was currently being fully comprehended by his true body, even setting aside the Fusion Rules because comprehending the Complete Space Rules first significantly enhances the efficiency of merging the Taiji Rules and various Cosmic Forces.

“Alright.”

Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan and said, warmly, “As for the second treasure, I suggest you choose this one.”

A thought from the stone statue, and a painting appeared in front of them.

Within the painting, a young tree swayed, emanating boundless and endless cosmic power of the World.
